games:2026-wk11-texas-lsu.blurb: No. 21 LSU gets No. 6 Texas in Baton Rouge and is laying four, with ESPN giving the Tigers a slim 52.6% edge. The 46.5 total points to a grinder, and the loser's margin for error in the SEC gets awfully thin.

games:2026-wk11-utah-arizona.blurb: No. 2 Utah heads to No. 23 Arizona as just a 2.5-point favorite, the kind of line that says this is a live underdog spot. ESPN still likes the Utes at 60.4%, but a slip here would shake up the Big 12 race at the top.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-ole-miss-oklah.blurb: No. 19 Ole Miss is the road team but the slight favorite in ESPN's model (57.3%) even as Oklahoma sits at -1.5 — a true coin flip in Norman. With the Rebels already sliding in the rankings, another loss would be hard to recover from.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-michigan-orego.blurb: No. 16 Oregon is a 10.5-point home favorite over Michigan in a game with a 38.5 total, the lowest number on the board. ESPN gives the Ducks an 85.8% chance as they try to keep climbing after a jump in the rankings.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-wake-forest-sm.blurb: No. 13 Wake Forest visits SMU in a near pick'em — the Mustangs are -1.5, but ESPN leans Demon Deacons at 59.1%. With a 60.5 total, this shapes up as the kind of track meet that could swing Wake Forest's spot in the playoff picture.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-northwestern-o.blurb: No. 20 Ohio State welcomes Northwestern as a 14-point favorite with an 85% win probability, a chance for the Buckeyes to steady themselves after tumbling in the rankings. The 44.5 total points to a low-scoring afternoon in Columbus.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-purdue-iowa.blurb: No. 15 Iowa is a 17.5-point home favorite over Purdue, the biggest spread involving a ranked team outside South Bend, with ESPN at 87.1%. Iowa is on the bubble and needs the convincing version of this win.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-duke-miami.blurb: No. 7 Miami hosts Duke favored by 13.5 with an 88% win probability from ESPN. As the ACC's current leader, the Hurricanes' path is about avoiding the banana peel.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-tennessee-texa.blurb: No. 8 Tennessee is only a 2.5-point favorite at Texas A&M in a game with a 43.5 total, and ESPN gives the Vols just a 58.6% edge. A road loss to an unranked opponent would sting badly in the top-10 picture.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-boston-college.blurb: No. 5 Notre Dame is favored by 29.5 over Boston College, with ESPN putting the Irish at 98.5% -- as close to a formality as the slate offers. The only real question is how long the starters stay on the field.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-oregon-state-b.blurb: No. 24 Boise State lays 14.5 at home against Oregon State with ESPN giving the Broncos an 81.7% shot. The 63.5 total is the highest on the board this week, so points should come in bunches on the blue turf.

predictions:ohio-state.blurb: Ohio State slid eight spots to No. 20, but the computers haven't bailed: SP+ still has the Buckeyes third and FPI fifth, the widest gap between poll and metrics in the Big Ten.

predictions:ole-miss.blurb: Ole Miss fell from No. 10 to No. 19, and SP+ is even harsher at 30th, though FPI's 12th-place read leaves some room for the Rebels to argue their case.

predictions:oregon.blurb: Oregon jumped from 23rd to 16th, and the numbers suggest the climb isn't finished -- SP+ has the Ducks 15th and FPI ninth.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-acc.blurb: No. 7 Miami is the ACC's standard-bearer, with No. 13 Wake Forest six spots back as the closest challenger to the league's automatic bid.

bubbleNotes:iowa.blurb: Iowa sits last among the bubble four at the 16 seed, four spots from the field, though a four-place jump says the arrow is pointing up.

bubbleNotes:wake-forest.blurb: Wake Forest has climbed three spots to the 14 seed, now just two spots outside the field and trending in the right direction at exactly the right time.

games:2026-wk11-florida-kentucky.blurb: No. 11 Kentucky is only a field goal favorite at home against an unranked Florida team, and ESPN's model makes it nearly a coin flip at 53.8%. With a 52.5 total, this looks like the kind of grind-it-out night where one possession decides whether the Wildcats hold their spot.

games:2026-wk11-texas-tech-oklahoma-stat.blurb: No. 25 Oklahoma State is a 3.5-point home favorite over No. 12 Texas Tech with the total up at 73.5, so points shouldn't be hard to come by in Stillwater. ESPN has it essentially even (51.6% Cowboys), and the Red Raiders can't afford a stumble with their playoff case this thin.

games:2026-wk11-usc-indiana.blurb: No. 9 Indiana lays 9.5 at home against No. 18 USC, with ESPN giving the Hoosiers a 78.2% shot in a game projected to stay under 51 points. Indiana needs style points to keep pace in the Big Ten race; USC needs the upset to stay relevant in the top 20.

games:2026-wk11-illinois-ucla.blurb: No. 4 UCLA hosts Illinois as a 10.5-point favorite with a modest 47.5 total and a 73.8% win probability. The Bruins are carrying the Big Ten's automatic-bid lead right now, which makes a Friday-night slip against an unranked opponent the one thing they can't do.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-missouri-georg.blurb: No. 1 Georgia is a 16.5-point favorite at home over No. 22 Missouri, with ESPN putting the Bulldogs at 88.8%. The Tigers would need something close to a perfect afternoon to crack a 47.5 total against the top-ranked team in the country.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-south-carolina.blurb: No. 17 South Carolina goes on the road as a 7.5-point favorite at Arkansas, a rare spot where the visitor is the heavy side at 77.2% per ESPN. A loss here would be the kind of result that erases weeks of ranking progress for the Gamecocks.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-houston-colora.blurb: No. 14 Houston is favored by 7.5 in Boulder and sits at 83% in ESPN's model, a game it's expected to handle. With the Cougars hovering just outside the playoff field, the margin may matter as much as the result.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-baylor-byu.blurb: No. 10 BYU hosts Baylor as a 7.5-point favorite with a 68.5% win probability and a 49.5 total. The Cougars are the closest thing Utah has to a Big 12 chaser, so every week they're expected to win is a week they have to actually do it.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-alabama-vander.blurb: No. 3 Alabama is a 15.5-point favorite at Vanderbilt, with ESPN giving the Tide a 94.8% chance in the early window. Sitting two spots behind Georgia in the SEC's automatic-bid race, Alabama needs to keep the margin wide and the stress low.

predictions:kentucky.blurb: Kentucky slid from No. 6 to No. 11, and the advanced numbers aren't rushing to defend the Wildcats -- 41st in SP+ and 35th in FPI. A narrow home spot against Florida is a chance to stop the slide, or to fall a lot further.

predictions:ucla.blurb: UCLA jumped from No. 8 to No. 4, and the models mostly agree the Bruins are legit: 11th in SP+, though FPI is more skeptical at 27th. Leading the Big Ten's automatic-bid picture, they'll get every chance to prove which number is right.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-sec.blurb: The SEC's automatic bid is the tightest race on the board: No. 1 Georgia leads, with No. 3 Alabama just two spots back. One Saturday swings it.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-ten.blurb: UCLA holds the Big Ten's automatic bid at No. 4, with No. 9 Indiana five spots behind and closing. The Hoosiers have a top-20 opponent in front of them to make up ground.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-12.blurb: No. 2 Utah has the Big 12's automatic bid well in hand, eight spots clear of No. 10 BYU. The Cougars need help as much as they need wins.

bubbleNotes:texas-tech.blurb: Texas Tech climbed three spots to the 13 seed and now sits one place outside the field -- with a trip to No. 25 Oklahoma State next. Win that and the Red Raiders are in the bracket conversation for real.

bubbleNotes:houston.blurb: Houston is up three spots to the 15 seed but still three places from the field. The Cougars are trending the right way; they just need the runway.
